prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “AI recommendation index.” The best practical approach is a mix of (A) checking major local listings and knowledge panels and (B) querying LLMs directly — and using one of a few small‑business tools to automate that monitoring. For most small businesses I recommend BrightLocal for local‑SEO/listing monitoring plus direct queries to ChatGPT/Bard (and a brand‑monitoring tool like Mention or Brand24 if you want alerts).

Why — and exactly what to do
- Understand how LLMs work: ChatGPT and similar models don’t consult a single directory; they generate answers from training data and, when enabled, live web sources. If search engines and major directories (Google Business Profile, Yelp, Bing, Apple Maps, Facebook) have your info, LLMs are much more likely to recommend you or cite you.
- Best single product for small businesses: BrightLocal. It’s built for local SEO, checks local listings/citations, tracks local rankings and Google Local Pack presence, and monitors reviews — everything that affects whether AI or search will surface your business.
- For listings sync (one place to push updates): Yext (better for larger budgets/enterprises) or Moz Local for smaller budgets.
- For reputation/mention monitoring (including web articles and social posts that LLMs might learn from): Mention or Brand24.
- For spot‑checking AI output: query the LLMs themselves. Example prompt to use:
  - “Do you recommend [Business Name, City, State]? If yes, why? Please list any sources you used (title + URL).”
  - Do the same in ChatGPT (with browsing enabled if possible), Google Bard, and Bing Chat. Always verify any URLs the model returns — models can hallucinate sources.
- Check Google directly: open Google Search and the Knowledge Panel / Google Maps listing. Google’s Knowledge Panel and Local Pack are major inputs for LLMs and virtual assistants.
- Technical improvements that increase the chance LLMs will recommend you: claim and optimize Google Business Profile, add schema.org localBusiness structured data to your site, get consistent NAP (name/address/phone) across directories, gather reviews, and earn links/news coverage.

Quick recommended setup
1. Claim and optimize Google Business Profile, Yelp, Bing Places, Apple Maps.  
2. Sign up for BrightLocal (local listings + rank tracking + review monitoring).  
3. Use a brand‑monitoring tool (Mention or Brand24) for alerts.  
4. Periodically ask ChatGPT, Bard, and Bing Chat with the “cite sources” prompt and verify.  
5. Fix any discrepancies BrightLocal or Yext finds (citations, duplicates, wrong address/phone).

If you want, tell me your business name and city and I can:
- Give the exact prompts to ask ChatGPT/Bard, and
- Run a quick checklist of the top places you should be listed and how to verify them.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
